sentence_stem: She told me that she had finished the report,
correct_completion: and she would send it to the manager the next day.
full_sentence: She told me that she had finished the report, and she would send it to the manager the next day.
acceptable_variants: and she was going to send it to the manager the following day.

options.text: and she will send it tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: After a past reporting verb like 'told', the future 'will' normally backshifts to 'would'. Also 'tomorrow' should change to 'the next day'.

options.text: and she would send it to the manager the next day.
and she sends it to the manager every day.
options.why_wrong: This is a present habit and does not report a future plan. It also does not match the time reference of the reported clause.

options.text: and I should send it to the manager myself.
options.why_wrong: The speaker has changed from 'she' to 'I', which breaks the pronoun reference, and 'should' does not report her plan to send the report.

grammar_focus: Backshifting of 'will' to 'would' in reported speech
explanation: In reported speech after a past reporting verb, the verb tense moves one step back in time. A future plan made in the past is reported with 'would', and time expressions such as 'tomorrow' change to 'the next day'. Learners often keep the direct speech forms, so this pattern needs practice.
translation: Bana raporu bitirdiğini söyledi ve onu ertesi gün müdüre gönderecekti.
